states.name: Layout Complete
states.description: Both objects are positioned in correct zones with rotation and scale configured, lighting adjusted
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && window.__3D_STATE__.bathtubInBathingZone === true && window.__3D_STATE__.coffeematInLoungeZone === true && typeof window.__3D_STATE__.ambientLightIntensity === 'number' && window.__3D_STATE__.ambientLightIntensity >= 0

states.name: Stable Configuration
states.description: All elements remain in valid positions with no user interaction for extended period
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && window.__3D_STATE__.bathtubInBathingZone === true && window.__3D_STATE__.coffeematInLoungeZone === true && window.__3D_STATE__.assetsLoaded === true

postconditions: Both GLB assets are loaded and visible in the scene

action.code: const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const evt = new MouseEvent('mousedown', {clientX: canvas.width * 0.3, clientY: canvas.height * 0.5, bubbles: true}); canvas.dispatchEvent(evt); setTimeout(() => { const move = new MouseEvent('mousemove', {clientX: canvas.width * 0.25, clientY: canvas.height * 0.5, bubbles: true}); canvas.dispatchEvent(move); setTimeout(() => { const up = new MouseEvent('mouseup', {clientX: canvas.width * 0.25, clientY: canvas.height * 0.5, bubbles: true}); canvas.dispatchEvent(up); }, 300); }, 300);

postconditions: Bathtub is positioned within the bathing zone

action.code: const rotSlider = document.querySelector('input[type="range"]'); if (rotSlider) { rotSlider.value = 180; rotSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }

const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const evt = new MouseEvent('mousedown', {clientX: canvas.width * 0.7, clientY: canvas.height * 0.5, bubbles: true}); canvas.dispatchEvent(evt); setTimeout(() => { const move = new MouseEvent('mousemove', {clientX: canvas.width * 0.75, clientY: canvas.height * 0.5, bubbles: true}); canvas.dispatchEvent(move); setTimeout(() => { const up = new MouseEvent('mouseup', {clientX: canvas.width * 0.75, clientY: canvas.height * 0.5, bubbles: true}); canvas.dispatchEvent(up); }, 300); }, 300);

postconditions: Coffee mat is positioned within the lounge zone

action.code: const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]'); if (sliders.length > 1) { sliders[1].value = 1.2; sliders[1].dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); } if (sliders.length > 2) { setTimeout(() => { sliders[2].value = 0.6; sliders[2].dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }, 500); }

postconditions: Scale and lighting have been adjusted
ambientLightIntensity is set to a valid value
